item.title: The Original Worlds of Timothy Zahn by Open Road Media
item.description: New worlds, far-flung adventures
item.content:encoded: Looking for a new science fiction author to stack your library? Or perhaps you’re already a big fan and you want to fill in some gaps? Either way, this bundle of Timothy Zahn’s best sci-fi novels is an essential collection to add to your digital bookshelves! Find the truth inside a black hole and save the empires of humanity in Angelmass! Fight back against alien overlords with the enhanced mercenaries of The Blackcollar! Follow a young con artist and his draconic companion as they uncover a dangerous intergalactic conspiracy in Dragon and Thief! Board an interstellar railway harboring a deadly mystery in Night Train to Rigel! Sample the author’s award-winning short fiction in Pawn’s Gambit: And Other Stratagems! There’s even more to explore in this bundle of adventures from the author of Star Wars’ Thrawn saga, so grab them now at the price of your choice and support the Comic Book Legal Defense Fund with your purchase!

item.title: Software Architecture 2026 by O'Reilly
item.description: Evolve your architecture skillsets with ease
item.content:encoded: Welcome fall with new goals, and realize them with our latest Software Architecture Bundle by O'Reilly. This curated selection of software architecture titles is the perfect resource for building your job-ready portfolio, mastering enterprise-level techniques, and so much more. Practical, approachable, and focused on growing your knowledge base, titles like Facilitating Software Architecture and Fundamentals of Enterprise Architecture have everything you need to flourish as a software architect. Shatter expectations in your career and help support Code for America with your purchase!

item.title: Masters of the Craft: A Megabundle by Valiant Entertainment
item.description: THE LEGENDS OF VALIANT — ALL IN ONE INCREDIBLE COLLECTION
item.content:encoded: Some of the greatest writers and artists in comics have left their mark on the Valiant Universe. Now, their extraordinary work comes together in one massive Humble Bundle. Experience Valiant through the work of legendary and acclaimed artists including Joe Quesada, Barry Windsor-Smith, Bob Layton, Cary Nord, Clayton Crain, Mico Suayan, and Lewis LaRosa — artists whose unforgettable imagery helped define Valiant across generations. And the stories are just as extraordinary. Discover groundbreaking work from an incredible roster of writers including Jim Shooter, Christopher Priest, Jeff Lemire, Matt Kindt, Robert Venditti, Joshua Dysart, Fred Van Lente, and Cullen Bunn — creators who helped build, reinvent, and expand one of the most acclaimed superhero universes in comics. From X-O Manowar and Bloodshot to Harbinger, Eternal Warrior, Shadowman and beyond, this isn't simply a collection of great Valiant stories. It's a showcase of the creators who made Valiant legendary. Explore an incredible collection of Valiant comics, choose your price, and support BINC with your purchase. The heroes are iconic. The creators are legendary. The Valiant Universe is yours.

item.title: Painting Nature with Watercolor from Open Road
item.description: Let your paintbrush do the talking
item.content:encoded: If you’ve ever tried watercolor painting, you’ll know it’s deceptively tricky to master—which is why we partnered with Open Road on this bundle of watercolor how-to ebooks! This library of over 30 instruction manuals has all the tips and tricks you need to capture the natural world around you with a pad of paper and a few brushstrokes. Learn how to paint all kinds of flowers, animals, landscapes, and coastal vistas, while focusing on realism or on honing your own unique style! Bring nature to life on the page with this bundle of watercolor ebooks, all of which are available for the price of your choice, and support Hero Initiative with your purchase!

item.title: Microcontroller Classics and More by Make
item.description: It’s time for a tech tuneup
item.content:encoded:
Take your curiosity about homebrew tech to the next level and gain the skills you need to become a pro on Raspberry Pi, the ultimate portable personal processing platform. This bundle offers everything you need to get started, like Wearable Electronics 2E, Getting Started with Raspberry Pi, Getting Started with Arduino 4E, and a physical ESP32 Kit that ships within 3–4 weeks! Pay what you want for the skills you need to create the next great gadget, and help support Electronic Frontier Foundation!

ESP32 Kit is only available in US.

item.title: Miniseries, Quick Hits, and Speedy Reads by Dynamite Comics
item.description: Adventures you can read in one sitting
item.content:encoded: Got a hankering for a new comic series but not really in the mood for something that’ll take ages to finish? This bundle from Dynamite Comics is full of short but sweet tales of the fantastic! Hop aboard a farcical action-romance with plenty of unexpected turns in Garth Ennis’ A Train Called Love! Irradiated rodents take the world by storm in Adolescent Radioactive Black Belt Hamsters! The pin-up queen returns for a rural Ireland adventure in Bettie Page and The Curse of the Banshee! Plus, catch up with classic heroes and heroines like John Carter and Red Sonja! All of this and more is included in this megabundle of mini-adventures, so grab them now at the price of your choice, and support the Comic Book Legal Defense Fund with your purchase!

item.title: Self-Reliance and Off-Grid Skills for Dummies
item.description: Thrive in any off-grid element!
item.content:encoded: Don’t just survive in the modern outdoors—thrive. Our newest For Dummies bundle features some of the hottest and most useful ebooks for individuals looking to have fun in the wild or start a craft career. Get amazing titles like Solar Power Your Home For Dummies, 2e, Vegetable Gardening For Dummies, 3e, How to Fix Everything For Dummies, and Ham Radio For Dummies, 4e. Plus, your purchase helps support Covenant House.

item.title: Image in the '20s: A Megabundle by Image Comics
item.description: New favorites, modern classics
item.content:encoded: The decade may only be half over, but the 2020s have been good to Image Comics, one of the most exciting publishers of the day that is consistently putting out great stuff. To celebrate Image’s recent successes, we’ve put together a megabundle of their best series, so that longtime fans and new readers can find their new favorite stories! This bundle includes collected volumes of tech dystopian superhero story The Dead Lucky, rural Canadian horror series Fishflies, intergalactic warrior drama Free Agents, geriatric battle royale action series Golden Rage, child vampire saga Little Monsters, and more! If those sound good to you, just wait to see what else is in store in this giant—and we mean giant—bundle of Image’s best new comics! Grab them now at the price of your choice, and support BINC with your purchase!

item.title: Dying Earth RPG Collection
item.description: Quips cut deeper than swords!
item.content:encoded: Enter a decadent world of wit and danger with The Dying Earth Roleplaying Game. Drawn from the classic tales of fantasy titan Jack Vance, prime inspiration for the settings, moods and spells of Dungeons & Dragons, and designed by roleplaying legend Robin D. Laws. Explore a wondrous, exhausted world. Trade pleasantries with its ravenous and articulate creatures. Match wits with rogues, merchants and arch-magicians, and pray your tongue is the sharper. The entire game line of rules, settings, maps and lore, yours for the merest pittance! Before the flickering sun winks out for good and takes this bundle with it. And should prying fools dare question you, explain that your purchase is motivated not by greed for absurdly good and fleeting bargains, but by pure charitable feeling toward the World Wildlife Fund.

item.title: The Greg Bear Birthday Bundle by Open Road Media
item.description: Celebrate the birthday of one of sci-fi’s masters
item.content:encoded: The world of science fiction lost a titan when novelist Greg Bear passed away in 2022, but his books remain a perfect example of exactly what sci-fi was always meant to be. Author of over 50 books and co-founder of San Diego Comic Con, Bear made loving sci-fi into a career that spanned five decades. His work, which tested the limits of human (and non-human) consciousness and looked toward the far future and beyond, inspires and excites readers to this day. To celebrate what would have been Greg Bear’s 75th Birthday, in partnership with Open Road Media, we’ve collected a bundle of his best novels including award-winning classics like first contact thriller Eon, alien invasion drama The Forge of God, and post-apocalyptic space odyssey Anvil of Stars! Get a motherlode of some of the best sci-fi ever written for the price of your choosing, and support the Science Fiction & Fantasy Writers Association with your purchase!

item.title: Tales From the Iron Kingdoms
item.description: Step into a world forged in steam and iron and tempered by war
item.content:encoded:
In Warmachine the earth shakes during fierce confrontations between six-ton constructs of iron and steel clash with the devastating force of a locomotive, towering warbeasts hurl themselves at their foes in a frenzy of claw and fang, and bold heroes set the battlefield ablaze with with a tempest of of arcane magic as they forge the fate of nations in the fires of destruction.

Immerse yourself in Warmachine lore with this bundle of novels and short story anthologies, set in iconic locations and telling the stories of heroes, villains, and some of the Iron Kingdoms' most pivotal events. Collect each volume of the Iron Kingdoms Excursions, Warcaster Chronicles, Warlock Sagas, and Called to Battle series and more as you learn the backstories of key characters like The Butcher of Khardov and encounter a wealth of different peoples and cultures.

Grab this 41-ebook bundle at the price of your choice, and support the Child's Play charity with your purchase!

Also returning by popular demand is a collection of 65 Iron Kingdoms RPG (IKRPG) items, including core and source books for the Full Metal Fantasy and 5e editions, GM toolkits, bestiary's, and maps, first presented in the March 2025 Iron Kingdoms Humble Bundle.

A world of adventure and full metal fantasy awaits in the Iron Kingdoms.

item.title: The Complete Certification Book Bundle - AWS, Azure, CompTIA, Google, Databricks and Cybersecurity by Mammoth
item.description: Ace your tech exams with confidence
item.content:encoded: It’s time to level up your expertise in tech—develop the fundamental skills needed to prepare for career-changing exams with our latest Book Bundle. This comprehensive curriculum of first-time Humble Exclusives by Mammoth Club offers a variety of books like Google Cloud Certified Generative AI Leader with Practice Exam, Databricks Generative AI Engineer Associate with Practice Exam, and more. Ace your AWS, CompTIA, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud certification exams with confidence, and help support Children's Miracle Network today.

item.title: Embedded Firmware Developer Toolkit by Packt
item.description: Build, Program, and Master the Brains behind Modern Devices
item.content:encoded: Take control of the hardware that powers the modern world with this hands-on embedded systems toolkit from Packt! Dive deep into microcontrollers, ARM Cortex-M development, RTOS, and embedded Linux as you build the skills needed to design, program, and optimize real-world devices. Whether you're an aspiring firmware engineer or an experienced developer expanding into embedded systems, this bundle equips you to write efficient code, manage hardware, and bring intelligent devices to life, while supporting charity with your purchase.

item.title: React in Production Mega Bundle 2026 by Packt
item.description: Design, build, and deploy production-ready React applications
item.content:encoded: React remains the most widely used web framework, powering more production applications and appearing in more job listings than any other framework. As AI-assisted development becomes the norm, knowing React well matters more, not less. This bundle brings together 17 books written by expert React practitioners and developers who build with it every day. Learn the design patterns and best practices behind React 19, get comfortable with hooks and state management, and understand the architecture decisions that separate a working demo from something that scales. Go further with TypeScript across the stack, full-stack development with popular frameworks and React Native for mobile. Whether you're learning React for the first time, prepping for your next interview, or leveling up how you build in production, this bundle gives you the depth to back it up. A portion of every purchase supports Breast Cancer Research Foundation. Build your complete React library before the deal ends!

item.title: The EC Comics Artists Library by Fantagraphics
item.description: Celebrate the art of these fantastic comics
item.content:encoded: Comics need great writers, sure, but they’d be nothing without the talented artists who put their blood, sweat, and tears into bringing these stories to life on the page. Our latest bundle in partnership with Fantagraphics celebrates the iconic artists behind EC Comics’ greatest hits! See the world of Ray Bradbury’s short stories like never before in Home to Stay! The Complete Ray Bradbury EC Stories illustrated by the likes of Reed Crandall, Frank Frazetta, Al Williamson, Wallace Wood, and more! Dive into the work of your favorite artists in collections like Jack Kamen’s Kamen’s Kalamity, Harvey Kurtzman’s Man and Superman, Jack Davis’ ’Taint the Meat… It’s The Humanity!, and Reed Crandall’s The High Cost of Dying. Get 40 collections highlighting EC Comics’ greatest artists for the price of your choice, and support Freedom to Read Foundation with your purchase!

item.title: The Humanoids Megabundle: Universes Unbound, Part 2 by Humanoids
item.description: Worlds of adventure in these comics
item.content:encoded: It’s no secret that Humanoids has long been one of the most exciting and unique publishers of comics for decades, and now you can add even more of their best stuff to your digital library! This new bundle in partnership with Humanoids features Shakespearean space operas, dystopian action-adventures, supernatural urban fantasies, and more! Rock out with the witches of Black Cat Social Club as they fight corporate demons and slay their gigs! Dive deeper into the legend Alejandro Jodorowsky’s worlds with Megalex and The Incal spinoff The Metabarons! Follow an orphaned boy with powers over the weather on his quest to find out the truth about his family in Child of the Storm! All this and more is included in this giant bundle of 40 fantastic comic series, so grab them now at the price of your choice and support children’s reading charity Reading Is Fundamental with your purchase!

item.title: Godzilla: Kaiju Rampage by IDW
item.description: Atomic breath not included
item.content:encoded:
Brace yourself for a kaiju-sized bundle of Godzilla comics from IDW Publishing! You’ve seen the King of the Monsters on the big screen, and now’s the time to find him in the pages of these fantastic comics. Dive into the biggest and best Godzilla stories in the Deluxe Edition of Godzilla’s 70th Anniversary! Witness the giant lizard’s comic evolution in Godzilla: The Monster Comic Art Collection! Have a little fun with offbeat favorites like Godzilla: Skate or Die and Starship Godzilla [Kai-Sei Era]: First Wars! And of course we had to include Earth’s mightiest protector in Godzilla Legends—Mothra: Queen of the Monsters! Titan adventures and more await in what we might as well call the King of the Bundles, so grab it now at the price of your choosing, and support Make-A-Wish Foundation with your purchase!

The titles in this bundle are available through Kobo.com. To access the content, create or log in to your Kobo.com account.

item.title: Software Engineering by Manning
item.description: Surefire software engineering ebooks by Manning
item.content:encoded: We see a bright future for you as a software engineer—let us and Manning Publications help you see the vision. Master the art of writing efficient programs with elite eBooks that start from square one or build your existing skill set. Pay what you want for expert-led titles like Architecture Modernization, Think Distributed Systems, Advanced Algorithms and Data Structures, 100 SQL Server Mistakes and How to Avoid Them, and more. Help support charity, develop your skills, and save some dough—you can’t beat that!

item.title: The BattleTech RPG Collection Encore by Catalyst Game Labs
item.description: Rule your universe
item.content:encoded:
Blast off to the stars and beyond with BattleTech! This sci-fi tabletop RPG sets players down in the middle of a space opera of epic proportions, where empires rise and fall and the future of humanity rests on your shoulders. This bundle of BattleTech ebooks from Catalyst Game Labs is full of guides, rulebooks, and storylines to put you and your party on the path to universal domination! Immerse yourself in the rich lore of the galaxy, pick which faction you’ll represent in the looming conflict, hop inside a BattleMech, and choose from a vast array of combat zones in which to test your mettle. Enter a universe of possibility with this BattleTech bundle—grab it now at the price of your choice, and support Gamers Outreach with your purchase!

Codes are redeemable through the DriveThruRPG website.

item.title: Disney Masters Collection and Originals by Fantagraphics
item.description: Comics starring your favorite Disney legends!
item.content:encoded: Iconic Disney characters take the world of comics by storm in this bundle of Disney Masters and original comic series from Fantagraphics! The greedy Scrooge McDuck journeys from the Yukon to Atlantis and beyond in Walt Disney’s Uncle Scrooge: The Diamond Jubilee Collection! Mickey Mouse goes steampunk in the retrofuturist odyssey Walt Disney’s Mickey Mouse Versus The Mouseton Society of Evil! Epic Mickey hops from your console to the pages of his own comics in the video game inspired Disney Epic Mickey: The Comics Collection! Join Mickey Mouse, Donald Duck, Uncle Scrooge, and more of your favorite Disney legends in new tales and classic adventures in this bundle for old fans and newcomers alike! Grab this collection now at the price of your choice, and support First Book charity with your purchase.
